text:

Tanbeeh
Home
Pricing
Contact

العربية
Call your customers when their order is ready — on their own phone

Tanbeeh replaces plastic buzzers. The customer scans a QR code, and their phone and your TV screen alert them the moment staff tap Ready. No app to install.

Start your 14-day free trial
Pricing

No card needed for the trial.

How it works in 3 steps
1
1. Issue a digital ticket

At the counter, staff tap New ticket. The customer scans the QR code and follows their order number.

2
2. Tap Ready

When the order is ready, staff tap Ready. The customer's phone and the TV screen in the restaurant show the number with sound.

3
3. The customer collects

The customer comes to the counter and staff mark the order Collected. Reports show waiting and pickup times.

What you get
No app for customers

Works in the phone browser with push notifications where supported and a live page everywhere else.

TV display

Turn any smart TV or tablet into a pickup screen showing preparing and ready numbers.

Arabic and English

Every screen works in Arabic (right to left) and English, with your own logo and colour.

Simple reports

Tickets per day, preparation time from ticket creation, pickup time and alert reach.
